author: Retro Game Corps
description:
DroidDeck is a new app that brings SteamOS to Android, allowing you to play PC games through Valve's ARM64 Proton and FEX translation. Here's a look at how this app is unique among other similar solutions.

DroidDeck: https://github.com/Droid-Deck/DroidDeck
